issues.where: crop M, upper third of the gap between the globe and the Sun
issues.what: A straight horizontal cutoff divides the nearly black sky above from the speckled, hazier sky below. It reads as the edge of a rectangular background layer and is visible in the full frame in image-05.png.
issues.fix: Extend the star field across the gap and blend its luminance and haze continuously so there is no hard mask boundary.

issues.where: crop V, lower crescent just inside the limb
issues.what: The crater rims and ridges smear into elongated, shiny streaks near the limb, while the neighboring terrain is much sharper.
issues.fix: Check the surface projection and grazing-angle texture filtering, then rebalance normal-map contrast so crater rims stay distinct without looking embossed.

issues.where: crops M and N, bright solar photosphere
issues.what: Large near-white patches wash out the fine photosphere texture, leaving the brightest parts looking smooth against the more textured gold areas.
issues.fix: Use a gentler highlight rolloff to retain granulation while keeping the corona bright.

issues.where: crop D, lower-left star field and adjacent night side
issues.what: An isolated cream-colored blur and a row of faint polygonal ghosts stand out against the pinpoint stars and sharply defined globe.
issues.fix: Reduce the opacity and size of the lens ghosts or remove the isolated bright reflection so it does not read as a stray object.

issues.where: inside the large shadowed crater, centre right (crops A, Q at about 732-1000, 324-560)
issues.what: two small bright white shapes sit inside the black shadow. They have no relief or shadow and look like stray debris or pasted objects, not terrain
issues.fix: remove the bright specks from the shadowed crater floor, or let them take the shadow so they read as lit peaks

issues.where: east wall and floor of the large crater (crops E, F, R, W)
issues.what: the wall terraces form tight concentric swirl lines, like brush strokes or a twirl filter, and look painted rather than eroded rock
issues.fix: replace the swirled striations with broken terraces, slump blocks and uneven scarps at varied spacing

issues.where: lit limb of Mercury, upper right (crops C, K, P)
issues.what: a warm orange halo hugs the bright limb, which an airless body should not have. It reads as a glow added to the layer edge
issues.fix: remove the rim glow so the limb meets space with a clean edge; leave only the lens bloom from the Sun as a separate, wider effect

issues.where: mid and foreground plains (crops O, T, U, V, X)
issues.what: coloured and white single-pixel glints are sprinkled over the regolith and read as glitter or noise, not grains in the sunlight
issues.fix: remove or desaturate the speckle highlights and keep the specular response of the regolith low

issues.where: far terrain toward the limb (crops B, C, I, J, K, L)
issues.what: craters near the horizon get soft and smeared, with a stretched, wiped look rather than detail that shrinks with distance
issues.fix: raise texture or mip detail at grazing angles (anisotropic filtering) so the distant craters stay crisp

issues.where: bright ray crater, upper left centre (crops B, K)
issues.what: the starburst rays are thin, even white spikes and look like a stamped sprite rather than ejecta deposits
issues.fix: vary the length, width and fade of the rays and blend them into the surrounding albedo

issues.where: Sun disc and corona, right edge (crops C, L, M, Q, R)
issues.what: the disc is a flat cream colour with no limb darkening, and the filaments of the corona and the prominence look smeared and painted
issues.fix: add limb darkening and granulation at native scale, and give the filaments of the corona and the prominence sharper, structured edges

issues.where: Milky Way band, left (crops G, H, N)
issues.what: the dust lanes have a noisy, clumped texture with dense clusters of uniform dots, which looks like a procedural fill
issues.fix: use a smoother gradient for the dust and vary star density and size so it doesn't look stamped

issues.where: night side of Mercury against the stars, lower half (crops D, T, U)
issues.what: where the dark disc cuts off the stars the boundary is soft and almost straight in places, so the edge of the sphere is hard to read
issues.fix: keep the occluding edge of the disc sharp and round against the starfield
